message.content: {"new_rules":[{"id":"supp_r1","text":"When the public task directs review of the charted yearly temperature readings for the 2005-2015 trend but does not state whether every intervening year must have a plotted reading, an endpoint-only magnitude assessment is not established if a year tick within that period lacks a visible marker or reading. The missing-data requirement remains a support gap rather than evidence for a different routing option.","component":"chart coverage and task relation","conditions":"Applies where an intervening labeled year has no visible plotted reading and the public task supplies no completeness or endpoint-assessment rule."}],"new_chains":[{"chain_id":"supp_c1","rule_id":"supp_r1","observations":[{"ref":"chart_1","location":"x-axis at the 2011 tick and connected line segment between 2010 and 2012","content":"The x-axis has an inscription \"2011\", while no black marker or adjacent temperature inscription is visible at that tick; the blue line connects the markers at 2010 and 2012 across it."}],"task_evidence":[{"ref":"public_task","path":"/chart_reference","content":"Use the charted yearly temperature readings as the basis for this routing decision."}],"claim_kind":"underdetermined","option_label":null,"claim":"Because the chart lacks a visible 2011 reading and the public task does not say whether the 2005-2015 magnitude may be assessed from endpoints despite an unplotted intervening year, the intended completeness requirement for the multi-year assessment is unresolved.","question_ids":["q2"],"relationship":"support_gap"}],"refinements":[{"id":"refine_1","target_chain_id":"base_c1","question_ids":["q1"],"added_observations":[{"ref":"chart_1","location":"plot labels and chart annotations","content":"Each visible plotted-point inscription begins with a \"$\" character and ends with \"°C\", including \"$24.0°C\" at 2005 and \"$10.0°C\" at 2015; no legend or annotation visibly defines the \"$\" character."}],"added_task_evidence":[],"condition_note":"The endpoint labels can be used as temperature readings only if the unexplained leading \"$\" is decorative or otherwise does not change the numeric values' binding to the Temperature (°C) axis.","reason":"The existing validity condition for endpoint inscriptions does not specifically identify the visible unexplained prefix as an open encoding condition."}],"question_responses":[{"question_id":"q1","outcome":"refined_existing","record_ids":["refine_1"],"covered_chain_ids":["base_c1"],"reason":"The refinement makes explicit that the chart provides no visible definition for the repeated leading \"$\" character, so its compatibility with the temperature-axis reading remains conditional."},{"question_id":"q2","outcome":"new_explanation","record_ids":["supp_c1"],"covered_chain_ids":["base_c1","base_c2"],"reason":"The initial chains address endpoint magnitude and the absent substantial-trend threshold, but do not represent the separate gap concerning whether the missing 2011 plotted reading permits endpoint-only assessment."}]}
